posts.name: waedens
posts.cooked: Previously we knew that the Aeon men existed, but we did not know their significance. We now know that they are part of a force that fights for the ultimate Villian. Looking back through the cards it turns out that the Visionary has fought the Aeon Men before as can be clearly seen in the art for Cerebral Hemorrhage. Based on the fact that she teleported away during a pitch battle with a Scion it is clear that she knows something about the ultimate challenge that the other heroes do not. Where was she going? Is she linked to OblivAeon in some other way from some other time? Any theories from those more versed in Sentinels lore than me?

posts.cooked: The simplest answer is just that Dark Visionary left because her greatest tool for success (Legacy) was defeated. posts.name: Dandolo
posts.cooked:
Dark Visionary's Bio states "Dark Visionary fights alongside the Sentinels of the Multiverse… for now…" and the original Visionary's Bio tells us "An inter-dimensional hitchhiker, another version of Vanessa who had made very, very different choices, now occupies a corner of her psyche"

In the image from the ARG called Scion's Aid the original Visionary is depicted instead of Dark Visionary.  My thought is in between when Dark Visionary teleported  away and the discussion with the Scion, Dark Visionary turned against the heros and the event from her tactics bio where "she was aided in clearing this dark aspect from her psyche, leaving her drained, but in complete control" occured.  Of course, I'm making a lot of assumptions so this could be dead wrong.
